title: Tracking-machine dispatch to its anchor configuration
statement: Let $M$ be a finite Turing machine over Boolean symbols, let $x$ and $y$ be finite Boolean words, let $c$ be a configuration of $M$ on input $y$, let $b$ be a Boolean tag, and let $n$ assign natural-number counter values to the $2(1+k)$ administrative tapes, where $k$ is the number of work tapes of $M$. Starting the tracking machine from the reference configuration with state control set to the all-returned bank phase, input-head position $1$ on $x$, buffer tapes storing the binary expansions of the counter values, all administrative heads at $0$, and empty output, one step yields the anchor configuration: the source configuration, tag, counter tapes, their heads, and output have the values specified by that anchor.
hypotheses_covered: A finite Turing machine $M$ over Boolean symbols
A configuration $c$ of $M$ relative to input $y$
Natural-number counts on the $2(1+k)$ administrative tapes
replaced: For every source configuration, tag bit, and counter values, one step of the tracking host from the all-returned bank phase yields the anchor control, with no change to the source time, any tape, any head, or the output.
